1.text: Amagambo y'umwami Lemuweli n'ubuhanuzi nyina yamwigishije:

2.text: “Mwana wanjye, ndakubwira iki?Ese nkubwire iki, mwana wanjye nibyariye,Ko ari wowe nahigiye?

3.text: Ntugahe abagore intege zawe n'ubugingo bwawe,Kuko ari cyo kigusha abami.

4.text: “Ntibikwiriye abami, Lemuweli we,Abami ntibakwiriye kunywa vino,Cyangwa ibikomangoma kubaririza ibisindisha aho biri.

5.text: Be kunywa bakibagirwa ibyategetswe,Bakagoreka imanza z'abarengana.

6.text: Ibisindisha ubihe ugiye gupfa,Na vino uyihe ufite intimba mu mutima.

7.text: Mureke anywe urwo rushungandushyi,Rumutere kwibagirwa intimba ye.

8.text: “Bumbura akanwa kawe uvugire ikiragi,Kandi uburanire abatagira shinge na rugero.

9.text: Bumbura akanwa kawe uce imanza zitabera,Ucire abakene n'indushyi urubanza rutunganye.”

10.text: Umugore w'imico myiza ni nde wamubona?Arusha cyane rwose marijani igiciro.

11.text: Umutima w'umugabo we uhora umwiringira,Kandi ntazabura kunguka.

12.text: Ahora amugirira neza ntabwo amugirira nabi,Igihe cyose akiriho.

13.text: Ashaka ubwoya bw'intama n'imigwegwe,Anezezwa no gukoresha amaboko ye.

14.text: Ameze nk'inkuge z'abagenza,Azana ibyokurya bye abikura kure.

15.text: Abyuka kare butaracya,Akagaburira abo mu rugo,Agategeka abaja be imirimo ibakwiriye.

16.text: Yitegereza umurima akawugura,Awutezamo urutoki mu by'inyungu ivuye mu maboko ye.

18.text: Abona yuko ibyo akora bimufitiye akamaro,Kandi nijoro itabaza rye ntirizima.

19.text: Afatisha ukuboko urubambo ruriho ipamba,Intoki ze zigafata igiti ahotoza.

20.text: Aramburira abakene ibiganza,Kandi indushyi akazitiza amaboko.

21.text: Ntatinyisha abo mu rugo igihe cy'imbeho,Kuko abo mu rugo bose bambaye ibikomeye by'imihemba.

22.text: Yibohera ibirago by'ibisuna,Imyambaro ye ni imyenda y'ibitare byiza n'imihengeri.

23.text: Umugabo we amenyekana mu marembo y'umudugudu,Yicaranye n'abakuru b'igihugu.

25.text: Imbaraga n'icyubahiro ni byo myambaro ye,Kandi igihe kizaza azaba agiseka atacyitayeho.

26.text: Abumbuza akanwa ke ubwenge,Kandi itegeko ry'ururimi rwe riva ku rukundo.

27.text: Amenya neza imico yo mu rugo rwe,Kandi ntabwo arya ibyokurya by'ubute.

28.text: Abana be barahaguruka bakamwita Munyamugisha,N'umugabo we na we aramushima ati

29.text: “Abagore benshi bagenza neza,Ariko weho urabarusha bose.”

30.text: Ubutoni burashukana kandi uburanga bwiza ni ubusa,Ariko umugore wubaha Uwiteka ni we uzashimwa.

31.text: Mumuhe ku mbuto ziva mu maboko ye,Kandi imirimo ye nibayimushimire mu marembo.
